notes.title: Redoing CG's!
notes.content:
Hello!


Many people pointed out that the intro CG's for this game didn't quite match the characters and I absolutely agree as they were drawn back in 2017 when the sprites looked very different LOL

So I (sumooli) will be redrawing them!

I will make the update once I redo those 3 CG's (and for fun maybe add an extra one?)

I also found that there was a problem with the cheating mini game so I will be working to get that fixed as well!

Oh and someone also mentioned that the description was misleading so I changed it! Hopefully it's more clear but without spoiling any details ahaha

 
Hopefully it will help the gameplay experience!



Thanks so much for your feedback !

xoxo,

Sumooli
